'''Mr. Monday Night War of the Jedi''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mr. Monday Night]]
* '''Published:''' 15 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 WHT Night LS 2001 Warofthe.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Standard WHT/DOTF deck!!
